title: Winsol
safeHtml:
'''Winsol''' is one of the Main Districts of Los Sengas. It is represented by pink-magenta, and became District Number 30 on January 8 2021.

History

When Nazca Railway extended northwards, the Los Sengas Government has named the four other districts within the Ingress Continent, one of which being Winsol, which did not see any Railway Development until Season 4, Episode 6 (S4E6). The name of this District can be traced back to the naming of Winter Point Gateway. Nazca Railway had plans to build three "Super-Checkpoints" between the end of Season 2 and Early Season 3, with one of them being located within Ingress Continent. Subsequent plans for Group 2 Gateways had seen the northeasterly Gateway coinciding with the location of the planned "Super-Checkpoint" at Ingress Continent, and hence the plans for Winter Point Gateway was formed. The "Winter" part of "Winsol" also ha its origins from that station.

However, four years after Winsol was named, neither Nazca Railway nor the Co-Op Railways had managed to set foot within this district, and only Route 3 passed through the middle of this district as a path between Asylum and Ingress, with no exits in between. Subsequently, Nazca Railway announced plans for the Ingress Continent in the 2024 Plans, and had even stated that Winter Point Gateway would be built in S4E6, and with the developer of Asylum having the willingness to develop Winsol in order to provide job opportunities for northeast Los Sengas residents and provide better connections, approval was granted in order to diversify Los Sengas Developement. Nonetheless, as Winter Point Gateway was not yet in use, Development has yet to commence except for the Asylum extension part.

This signifies that Platform 6 is to the north of Platform 7 on the upper level. This signifies that Platform 8 is to the north of Platform 5 on the lower level.

'''World Gazette''', abbreviated as '''WG''', is a Licensed Media Organization in Los Sengas. While the Media and Broadcasting Authority (MBA) had once annoucned that it would discontinue its media license, it was agreed in the 26th Project Nazca conference that this media outlet could continue to operate.

Description

World Gazette is the first privately run Media Outlet in Los Sengas, and mainly operate as an Electronic Media.

  • Address: No.2-8, Coronation Road, Los Sengas
  • Name of Owner: sunnyau
  • License Operating Area: All of Los Sengas
  • License Expiry Date: Until March 28 2017Project Nazca</ref>

Access

Currently, its headquarter is located at No.2-8, Coronation Road

Controversies

Despite releasing news more frequently and having more staff members than Inter-Galactic Media Group (IGMG), the news quality of this media outlet has been put into scrutiny, and misstatements, as well as conflicts arising betwen players and this media group, are not rare. Project Nazca</ref>.
